# Lower <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Lower:String string:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text. |

**Returns:** The lower case text.

## Description

Returns a copy of the string with every letter in lower case.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Lower$("Hello World 1!")
```

```text
hello world 1!
```
